oracle.semantic_layer: Runner gate success criteria describe protocol-visible behavior between publisher, relay, and subscriber roles without prescribing an implementation.
oracle.binding_rule: Exact vectors and executable functions belong to driver bindings and evidence; they are not normative protocol behavior.
oracle.binding_reference_rule: gate_normative_references apply to the implementation-neutral semantic contract; binding-specific references and limitations are labeled by driver binding.
oracle.independence_rule: moxygen and each controlled independent driver must not port or share each other's generators or assertions

identifier_policy.profile_id: The profile ID identifies enduring protocol semantics through RFC publication and never encodes a draft version or implementation revision.
identifier_policy.gate_ids: Gate IDs identify enduring protocol semantics through RFC publication and never encode a draft version, source ordinal, or implementation revision.
identifier_policy.source_binding_ids: The seven gate-mapped source bindings share enduring semantic test IDs with their gates. The other 51 IDs are semantic inventory handles for this profile revision, not canonical executable tests until they receive formal contracts.
identifier_policy.unified_semantic_test_ids: One semantic test ID can have multiple driver bindings; a gate and its moxygen source binding intentionally share that ID when they represent the same protocol behavior.
identifier_policy.source_ordinals_and_names: ordinal and source_name reproduce declarations in the pinned moxygen script as separate source provenance and do not define identifier semantics.
identifier_policy.equivalent_migration: An equivalent editorial or section-only migration that preserves semantics, pass criteria, and applicability retains the ID and updates every reference atomically.
identifier_policy.semantic_change: An incompatible change to semantics, pass criteria, or applicability permanently retires the old ID and introduces a new semantic ID.
identifier_policy.retired_id_reuse: The retired-ID history is append-only, and a retired ID is never reused.

identifier_history.compatibility: The prior draft-specific profile commit was unpublished and produced no accepted ecosystem identifiers or results; therefore this semantic migration requires no aliases or retirement entries.

execution_policy.rule: Each result selects its diagnostic gate timeout by gate ID and driver binding. The moxygen wrapper starts its 10000 ms timeout after publisher readiness. The independent driver allows 10000 ms for peer rendezvous plus a 2000 ms client readiness margin, producing a 12000 ms readiness ceiling, followed by 10000 ms for delivery and terminal observation, for a 22000 ms result timeout. Intended moxygen source-case timeouts are unchanged. The seven-gate TAP-only moxygen registration uses 70000 ms of case windows and must complete within the 120000 ms runner whole-container limit.

executable_requirements.tls_disable_verify: A future moxygen conformance driver must honor TLS_DISABLE_VERIFY exactly; baseline source behavior that always installs an insecure verifier is not acceptable executable provenance.
executable_requirements.resolved_provenance: Execution is disabled until the selected driver landing SHA and image provenance are resolved. Result records require full executable SHAs and never accept TBD.

moxygen_global_cross_stream_ordering.description: The reviewed moxygen baseline can falsely fail when independently scheduled subgroup streams arrive in a different global group order.
moxygen_global_cross_stream_ordering.result_rule: Before registration, retain an ordering-only mismatch only in manual evidence as driver-inconclusive with evaluator verdict inconclusive; never classify the relay as failed. The current TAP report cannot represent this state.

disposition_reasons.profiled-subscribe-stream: Intended for runner execution as a subscription stream case; intended is a plan, not an observed support claim.
disposition_reasons.delivery-timeout-parameter-only: Intended only for non-expiring delivery-timeout parameter observation; timeout expiration is not claimed.
disposition_reasons.fetch-unsupported: Deferred because FETCH is outside this profile and no FETCH support is claimed.
disposition_reasons.datagram-unsupported: Deferred because datagram delivery is outside this profile and no datagram support is claimed.
disposition_reasons.object-status-unsupported: Deferred because the declaration requests explicit end-of-group/Object Status behavior, which is outside this profile.
disposition_reasons.invalid-object-property-scope: Deferred because the source emits Object Property type 0x02, but OBJECT_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT is Track-only for the target draft.
disposition_reasons.subscribe-tracks-unsupported: Deferred because the composite PUBLISH topology requires SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS, which is outside this profile.
disposition_reasons.subscribe-tracks-request-update-unsuppor: Deferred because the publish-first composite topology requires SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS and REQUEST_UPDATE, both outside this profile.
disposition_reasons.publisher-delivery-timeout-unsupported: Deferred because publisher delivery timeout behavior and timeout expiration are outside this profile.

implementation_independence_classes.planned-independent-gate: This moxygen source binding maps to a runner gate that also has a separately authored independent publisher/subscriber binding.
implementation_independence_classes.profile-inventory-only: Inventoried as intended, but no independent canonical diagnostic gate is specified in this revision.
implementation_independence_classes.deferred-unsupported: Excluded from execution and support claims in this revision.

result_semantics.meaning: All fail-closed criteria were satisfied within the selected binding timeout and required evidence is complete.
At least one protocol criterion or selected binding fixture expectation was contradicted by complete evidence.
Execution reached the test but evidence cannot distinguish pass from fail.
The selected case or required capability is not implemented by the client.
Setup, readiness, orchestration, parsing, or evidence capture failed.

required_evidence.publisher-readiness: Binding-specific evidence that the active publisher route was ready for this exact case, not a separate announce-only probe.
required_evidence.control-observations: Decoded SETUP, SUBSCRIBE, SUBSCRIBE_OK or REQUEST_ERROR, and PUBLISH_DONE or request termination observations with connection roles and ordering.
required_evidence.object-observations: Per-object group ID, object ID, subgroup ID, exact payload bytes and digest, publisher priority, and raw plus decoded Object Property type/value observations.
required_evidence.delivery-observations: Binding-specific wire-level or serve-model delivery observations sufficient for that binding's declared assertions.
required_evidence.tap14: The complete TAP version 14 output and process exit code.
required_evidence.process-logs: Complete publisher-driver, relay, and subscriber-driver stdout and stderr with timestamps.
required_evidence.reproduction-metadata: A result record conforming to result_record_contract, including exact revisions and deployment provenance.

moxygen_driver.readiness: Observe PUBLISH_NAMESPACE REQUEST_OK for the same active case before starting its subscriber; an announce-only run is not proof of case readiness.
moxygen_driver.completion: Wire evidence accounts for the expected objects and stream FIN dispositions.

independent_driver.readiness: Observe both SUBSCRIBE_OK and exact namespace-plus-track routing to the publisher serve model.
independent_driver.completion: Observe TRACK_ENDED after the finite serve-model fixture is consumed.

result_record_contract.identity_rule: profile_id, profile_revision, target_draft, gate_id, and gate_revision preserve interpretation; one semantic gate ID can have multiple driver bindings, and source_binding is populated only for the moxygen driver binding.

state_model.rule: Disposition is profile eligibility, execution is what happened, evaluator_verdict is the evidence judgment, and claimed_outcome is the driver or exported claim under evaluation. A claimed pass can be overturned by the evaluator. Fail requires complete verified evidence and provenance, the exact required assertion set, at least one failed assertion, and a contradiction classification. Inconclusive requires a not-observed assertion or non-verified evidence/provenance and uses none or driver-inconclusive. Unsupported requires evaluator and claimed outcome unsupported, none classification, and assertions absent or not-observed. Harness-error and null verdicts use none.

evidence_descriptor.digest: SHA-256 over the exact referenced evidence bytes, encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Schema and jq validation check syntax only; external publication must recompute each digest from the artifact bytes.

opaque_deployment_policy.rule: A deployment with no verifiable image digest must use visibility=opaque, image_digest=null, and a non-empty opaque reason and locator. It must not use a guessed digest or be described as reproducible.
opaque_deployment_policy.result_handling: Opaque runs may report protocol observations, but the record must set reproducibility=opaque and preserve the limitation in every exported claim.

result_record_contract.phase_timing_rule: independent_driver optionally records setup_ms as concurrent role setup wall time, then records readiness_ms at most the 12000 peer-rendezvous-plus-client-margin ceiling and delivery_terminal_ms at most 10000. moxygen_driver records publisher_readiness_ms at most 10000 and case_ms at most its selected 10000 gate timeout. duration_ms is aggregate process time and must be at least the sum of the binding's recorded sequential wall-clock phases.
result_record_contract.assertion_linkage_rule: Every assertion ID belongs to the selected gate required_assertion_ids. A pass contains exactly that complete set with pass status and non-empty evidence references.
result_record_contract.driver_provenance_rule: driver_review_baseline_sha resolves through the selected profile binding; driver_landing_sha equals publisher and subscriber deployment source_sha for that binding.
result_record_contract.verification_rule: reproducibility and independence_class are submitted claims. A publishable evaluator pass requires evidence_integrity_verification=verified and provenance_verification=verified from external publication tooling.
result_record_contract.executable_provenance_rule: Manifest executable landing fields may be unresolved/TBD, but executable result records require full 40-character landing SHAs and must never contain TBD.
